correctness.rationale: Given Bayer et al. Theorem 2.3 vertex characterization, translated polytope has 16 symbolic vertices, reduced to 10 when C=0. Determinant is multi-affine in four corners; vertex quadruple suffices for maximum. Independent sympy generated all C(16,4)=1820 symbolic determinants: exactly two ±(A^3+B^3), six ±B²(C+A) and 1812 others with for both signs coefficientwise nonnegative nonzero margin below A^3+B^3; C=0 coincidences collapse. Convex combinations of signed determinants show nonvertex equality is possible only via the six top apex vertices sharing three axial vertices; gives full 2D permutahedral apex face. Δ=(d-e)C²+(2d²+e²)C+d³+d²e+2de²+e³ switches once if e>d, never if e<=d; tested including C=0. This exact polynomial certificate plus multiaffinity proves full real C≥0,d,e>0, not merely finite samples.
